howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Strike called numbers on your tickets — finish a pattern to win a prize.
howToPlay.s1: Create a room, or join with a room code or a shared link. The host approves who joins. Someone accepted during a game watches now and plays from the next game. Normal = one game (play again any time); Series = game after game with the next lobby opening by itself.
howToPlay.s2: The host chooses. Free: no price at all. Coins: everyone gets 1,000 free play coins — tickets cost coins and prizes pay coins (coins have no money value). ₹ Amount: amounts only to keep score, no payments.
howToPlay.s3: Players join → host taps Next → everyone takes tickets → host taps Next → host sets the prizes → everyone taps I’m ready → host starts. Something wrong? Tell the host from the ready card.
howToPlay.s4: Take from 1 ticket up to the host’s limit (3 by default, up to 10). You confirm once — no changes that game. Your tickets share very few numbers, so together they cover more of the board.
howToPlay.s5: Every phone speaks the numbers in English or Telugu. Tap a called number on your ticket to strike it. With Auto hint on, the newest number glows until the next call (or every called number until you strike it, if the host chose that).
howToPlay.s6: Fast 3 / 5 / 7, First / Second / Third Line, Left / Center / Right Column and Full Housie. Before every game the host picks the prizes and amounts — they always add up to the pot.
howToPlay.s7: When your strikes finish a prize it is claimed for you. Normal: everyone gets time to check, and winners on the same number share equally; with Late claim, a player who finished earlier and claims within a few numbers wins it. Fastest finger: the first claim wins. Auto: the app strikes for you.
howToPlay.s8: Chat with the room, ask the host to pause, and watch the winner card on every phone. Standings save every win, game by game.

seeta.title: Find Seeta
seeta.tagline: Secret roles from the Ramayana. Ram has one guess to find Seeta!
seeta.step1: Every round each player gets a secret role: Ram, Seeta, Lakshmana, Bharatha, Anjaneya…
seeta.step2: Ram shows himself. Everyone else keeps their role secret.
seeta.step3: Ram picks who he thinks is Seeta. Right → Ram keeps 1000 points. Wrong → Seeta takes Ram’s 1000.
seeta.step4: Everyone else always gets their role’s points. Most points after all rounds wins.

snakes.title: Snakes & Ladders
snakes.tagline: Roll the die, climb the ladders, dodge the snakes — first to 100 wins!
snakes.step1: 2–10 players take turns rolling the die. Everyone starts off the board.
snakes.step2: Roll a 1 to come onto square 1. Then your pawn walks as many squares as you roll.
snakes.step3: Land on a ladder’s foot → climb up! Land on a snake’s head → slide down to its tail. A 6 rolls again.
snakes.step4: You need the exact number to finish. First to reach 100 wins.

chamma.title: Ashta Chamma
chamma.tagline: The classic Telugu board game — throw 4 tamarind seeds and race your pawns home!
chamma.step1: 2–4 players, 4 pawns each, on a 5×5 board. Throw 4 seeds: seeds facing up = your number; none up = 8 (Ashta).
chamma.step2: A pawn comes in only on a 4 (Chamma) or an 8 (Ashta). 4, 8 or a cut gives another throw.
chamma.step3: Land on an opponent (not on a ✕ safe square) to cut it back home. Pawns go round the outer ring until you have cut one.
chamma.step4: After a cut your pawns can enter the inner ring and reach the centre. All 4 pawns home wins!
